about: One line descriptions for the notes used most (decision 8 of docs/NOTES-PAGE-PLAN.md): what the material is and where it comes from, factual, in our own words, at most 90 characters, no hyphens or dashes, British English. Written for PriceSniffs from general knowledge; no text was taken from any other site (docs/DECISIONS.md D26). Shown on the note page; a note without one shows its group's line, named as the group's. Checked by tests/noteGroups.test.ts.
author: Claude Opus 5.5, 9 Oct 2026, for the owner to spot check (decision 8)
